$comment: DOCUMENTS THE CMP/WASM PLAYER CANNOT DRAW YET, temporarily allowed past the gate design-artifacts.yml enforces. Every entry names the player gap and expires, because an allowlist that does not expire is a gate that has been switched off. An entry whose id no longer exists is WORSE than no entry: it protects nothing while making the list look maintained, which is how this file came to hold six dead ids from before the #116 taxonomy fold (old component names, 200dp/320dp frames) while eight live failures blocked every remote-m3 publish from 2026-08-29 15:50 onward. Take ids from the lane's own output — the `CMP/Wasm: n/m rendered` block prints them — rather than from previews.json, whose spelling of the frame differs. REMOVED 2026-09-02: the four `ImageBackgroundRemoteButton` entries. The lane now renders them — actions/runs/33668348892 reported `388/392 rendered, 4 temporarily allowed, 1 failed` with the four allowed being the THEME SPECIMENS, and the button scoring `34.89% (Android) vs cmp-wasm 34.62%`, the two players agreeing to within 0.3%. So paint commands 22 (SHADER_MATRIX) and 24 (TEXTURE) are implemented in CMP/Wasm now and the entries protected nothing. Note this does NOT mean the button draws its image: both players render the same opaque container, which is a separate defect tracked on https://github.com/yschimke/wear-m3-catalog/issues/157 — an allowlist entry is about whether the lane can render a document at all, not about whether the picture is right.
